description: Create 4 Raycast Quicklinks that exercise dynamic placeholders, named arguments with defaults, and the clipboard placeholder. Then export the full set to ~/Desktop/my_quicklinks.json using Raycast's Export Quicklinks command. The 4 Quicklinks: (a) YouTube Search — opens https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=<query> where <query> is a prompted argument. (b) GitHub Code Search — opens https://github.com/search?q=<keywords>&type=code&l=<language> where 'keywords' is a required argument and 'language' is a named argument with default value 'python'. (c) Translate Clipboard — opens https://translate.google.com/?sl=auto&tl=<target>&text=<clipboard>&op=translate where 'target' is a named argument with default 'es' and <clipboard> uses the {clipboard} placeholder (apply the trim modifier). (d) Maps Directions — opens https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=Pittsburgh,PA&destination=<destination> where <destination> is a prompted argument. Use Raycast's documented placeholder syntax: {Query}, {argument name="..." default="..."}, {clipboard | trim}.
